svg.title: A Request Was Not the Same as an Uprising
svg.desc: Action type: A formal request and a collective uprising are different recorded actions.. Named request: The Bacolor case concerns a petition about tribute-collection duties in 1698.. Aim and result: Seeking changed terms does not automatically mean every demand was granted or all rule was rejected.
